conditions.A: Exact saved committed representations; checkpoint Wq/Wk unchanged
conditions.B: Actual saved terminal live states; checkpoint Wq/Wk unchanged
conditions.B_global: One alpha multiplied into every raw candidate and query representation; no per-vector or separate group scaling
conditions.C: Each raw vector divided by its L2 norm; no learned gain; original Wq/Wk

global_scalar_recipe: alpha = pooled_RMS(committed queries and candidates) / pooled_RMS(raw queries and candidates), pooling all32x64 coordinates equally. No targets used.
decomposition: b=Kc @ mean(Q)/8; I=Qc @ Kc.T/8; Srow=1 b.T+I

metrics.target_rank: competition rank 1+number strictly greater; stable index-broken rank also retained
metrics.target_margin: target score minus largest incorrect score
metrics.pair_margins: all240 target-minus-incorrect margins; not independent observations
metrics.global_scalar_check: all argmax predictions and full candidate rankings unchanged between B and B_global

interpretation: Analytic readouts of retained states only. No recomputed persistent trajectories, new learned interfaces or evidence of parameter realizability. B versus C differs only by per-vector radii; A also includes learned coordinate gains and RMS epsilon.
uncertainty: Descriptive single-array comparison only; no bootstrap or inferential intervals
